text:
maya: Morning — quick clarity needed. ACME is running a 2h demo tomorrow at 03:00 UTC in APAC. Can we guarantee 4x H100s in ap-northeast1 for that window? Who owns the vendor carve for that time?
sam: You mean ap-northeast1? We currently have a soft-hold with cloud-supplier until 04:00 UTC but no confirmed reservation. Did you file a reservation ticket?
maya: Not yet — didn't want to double-book. If ops can confirm, I'll submit the chargeback. @ops-bot any reservation pinned for acme-prod?
ops-bot: Reservation lookup: tenant=acme-prod, window=2025-11-12T03:00Z-05:00Z -> soft-hold by partner 'cloud-supplier' (expires 2025-11-11T23:00Z). No confirmed reservation.
leo: We can confirm via procurement but Finance needs a cost center. @billing-bot what's the rough delta for 4 H100s x2h in apac?
billing-bot: Estimate: 4 H100s x2h = ~$2,400 (vendor on-demand). Add ~10% buffer for egress/network: ~$2,640. Provide cost center tag to auto-reserve.
maya: Cost center: AI-Demos / proj:acme-pilot. Can procurement do a provisional reserve and we convert to committed if usage looks high?
jia: For provisional reserve we need a PR + approver (tara). I can draft the PR template: "short-term-demo-reserve — acme-prod — 4 H100s — 2h". Want me to open it?
maya: Please do. Also confirm fallback to A100 mix is allowed if H100s aren't available.
sam: Fallback is allowed but performance differs. Set routing policy to prefer h100, fallback to a100. Runtime will auto-route. Example: `fallback_policy: ["h100","a100"]`.
maya: Snippet I'll add to the infra PR:
resource "redwood_reservation" "acme_demo" {
  region = "ap-northeast1"
  model_pref = ["h100"]
  fallback = ["a100"]
  count = 4
  window = "2025-11-12T03:00Z/2025-11-12T05:00Z"
  cost_center = "AI-Demos"
}

leo: LGTM. @tara can you approve once PR lands? Also add note: "convert to committed if usage > 8h/month".
tara: I'll review — ping me when PR created. Quick Q: who's owning rollback if vendor cancels last-minute?
jia: Ops will own rollback. @sam can you coordinate fallback and run canaries (two 10-min slices)?
sam: Yup. I'll run canaries at start and +30min, and switch to a100 if failures >3 within 5m. Will document in runbook.
maya: Thanks all — opening PR now and tagging @tara. ACME ticket for context: https://acme.internal/ticket/4321
ops-bot: Ticket attached to reservation request. Reservation draft id: rdw-87321. Status: pending procurement approval.
billing-bot: Reminder: include cost_center tag on PR so auto-charge works; otherwise manual invoice.
maya: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/7890 — cc @tara. rdw-87321 added to PR description.
tara: Reviewing now. Small nit: please add `notify: ["eng-oncall","product"]` to the resource.
maya: Done. Thanks :thumbsup: 
ops-bot: Reservation rdw-87321 status: approved by procurement. Allocation confirmed: 4 H100s ap-northeast1 03:00-05:00 UTC.
sam: Great — I'll schedule canaries and merge fallback config into deployment. Closing this thread after PR merge.
maya: Merged and noted runbook. Closing. :white_check_mark:
